goal: Make every VII business-detail template polished, readable and complete in Hebrew, English, Russian and French, then publish and verify it.

requirements.statement: Redesign the desktop review display into a clear, premium and readable composition.
evidence: Local desktop screenshots show a dedicated score summary and a balanced two-column review card layout.

requirements.statement: Localize and verify review display, empty, pending, modal, validation, error, submission and success states in four languages.
evidence: Explicit HE, EN, RU and FR review copy added; automated localization and review persistence tests passed.

requirements.statement: Remove untranslated interface Hebrew and mixed-language dynamic copy from every business-detail template.
evidence: Eight-state browser matrix found no visible or accessible Hebrew residue on EN, RU or FR routes.

requirements.statement: Prevent localized text from clipping, overflowing or creating unusable controls on desktop and mobile.
evidence: Eight-state browser matrix found no horizontal overflow and no overflowing controls.

requirements.statement: Preserve gallery, save, share, phone, WhatsApp, booking, map, accessibility, FAQ and navigation behavior.
evidence: Full suite passed 732/732, including gallery, booking, WhatsApp, map, accessibility and navigation contracts.

requirements.statement: Pass focused tests, full build, typography and responsive visual checks.
evidence: Production build passed; 732/732 tests passed; typography source audit passed; visual matrix passed HE/EN/RU/FR on desktop and 390px mobile.

requirements.statement: Publish one exact production release with rollback evidence and independent review.

invariants: Verified supplier facts and source media are unchanged.
Booking, lead, phone, WhatsApp, share, favorite and map contracts are unchanged.
No database schema, secret, binding, domain, schedule or supplier API mutation is in scope.
Illustrative or source-language business content is never misrepresented as independently verified translation.
